metadata.title: Regrid Parcel Data - Overview & Coverage
metadata.author: Regrid
metadata.shortDescription:
Listen to Matt Hampel (Sr. Architect at Regrid) give a complete overview & demo of the Regrid Parcel Data during our live webinar session.

Topics covered in this video are:
1. Introduction of Regrid Parcel Data
2. Coverage & attribution
3. Data update & refresh frequency
4. Standard & premium fields
5. Data Delivery Methods
6. Support docs & live Q& A
